Name: Hello SMAPI
Author: JessebotX
Description:
[size=2]This is the greatest mod of all time. Mod of the generation. - Myself (and so should everybody)[/size]

[u][b][size=6]Features
[/size][/b][/u][list]
[*][size=2]Type in[/size] [font=Courier New]Hello[/font], [font=Courier New]Hey [/font]or [font=Courier New]Hi[/font] [size=2]in the SMAPI console. By default, there are 60 responses.[/size]
[*][size=2]Have the best conversations ever:[/size]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- hi
﻿ ﻿- "Hello my prince"
﻿ ﻿- hello
﻿ ﻿- "Stop annoying me"
﻿ ﻿- hey
﻿ ﻿- "shut up"
﻿ ﻿- hi
﻿ ﻿- "Go away"
﻿ ﻿- hi
﻿ - "An honor to speak to you" [list]
[*][size=2]Add more responses or delete some of them in the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]. (basically make SMAPI say anything you want)[/size]
[/list]
[b][u][size=6]Compatibility
[/size][/u][/b][list]
[*][size=2]Works and tested on SMAPI 2.11.3+ and SDV 1.3+[/size]
[*][size=2]No known mod conflicts.[/size]
[/list]
